cohort: Approximately 3,900 mothers enrolled in two cohort studies in Canada and France
finding: While both cohorts had similar breastfeeding initiation rates, several factors were associated with breastfeeding initiation differently between the two countries, highlighting the need for tailored interventions.
mod_finding: Younger mothers in Canada who delivered by Cesarean section and who had previous children had reduced odds of breastfeeding initiation, but these results were not found for mothers in France.
